rules.decision: vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, Mooncake, Ray Serve, KServe/llm-d, TGI, KTransformers, and similar products retain ownership of their core runtime behavior.
Dry-run artifacts can describe implementation and migration readiness but cannot prove throughput, latency, GPU timing, or production SLO.
Replay artifacts can explain imported logs or traces but cannot prove live endpoint behavior.
Performance numbers must originate from results/raw/*.json and preserve their mode.
